title: Resurfaced strip along road edges
description: When Greece rolled out internet across the country, a narrow strip of asphalt was removed along road edges to lay cables and then refilled with newer asphalt. Greek roads therefore very often show a differently coloured strip along the edge.

title: STOP signs
description: The Greek STOP sign is recognisable by its thick white border and a very wide, tall font that fills almost the whole sign.
